speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
text: That said, in the healthcare regulatory world, there are many collaborations and partnerships.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
text: Highly regarded regulatory bodies become references for others, just as Singapore is a reference for others and we also reference other highly reputable jurisdictions.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: The recent United States (US) Food and Drug Administration's (FDA's) hesitation over Moderna’s mRNA flu vaccine suggests that regulators around the world can have differing views on assessments.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: So, can the Senior Minister of State explain how HSA ensures its decisions are not simply aligned to some of these US or United Kingdom (UK) regulators?
